dashboard.bannerDesc: Verify licensing, isolated Telegram listener sessions, broker connector detection, risk guard ceilings, and run an end-to-end synthetic demo trade with sub-millisecond execution verification.

wizard.modalSubtitle: Guided verification for licensing, isolated Telegram listener, broker bridge, and sub-ms trade execution.

step1.title: License Authentication & Offline Grace
step1.desc: Enter your Pipvane v3 license key or 30-day token. The engine connects to the local cryptographic authority to verify your lease. Once active, Pipvane runs with zero cloud UI dependency for up to 30 days (FR-8.4).
step1.productKeyLabel: Pipvane Product Key / Offline Lease Token
step1.failureNotice: Notice: Step 2 (Telegram Connect) remains locked until a valid cryptographic token is authenticated.
step1.successDesc: Local DPAPI vault updated. 30-day offline grace lease granted successfully.

step2.title: Telegram Safety Mode (Read-Only Listener)
step2.desc: Pipvane uses an isolated TDLib embedded session with strictly read-only MTProto access. It cannot post, message your contacts, or delete history. Your session encryption key never leaves your local machine.
step2.toggleDesc: Restricts the TDLib engine to message reception events only.
step2.scanTitle: Scan with your Telegram Mobile App
step2.scanStep1: Open Telegram on your mobile device
step2.scanStep2: Go to Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device
step2.scanStep3: Point your camera at this QR code to authorize the local bridge
step2.phoneHelper: Enter phone with country code. A Telegram verification code will be dispatched.

step3.title: Broker Terminal Detection
step3.desc: Auto-detects MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, and cTrader instances running on this PC.
step3.bridgeInfo: MQL5 / cTrader Native DLL & Named Pipe installed into terminal directories automatically.

step4.optEquityDesc: Calculates lot size based on account balance and stop loss distance.
step4.optFixedDesc: Executes every copied signal with an exact static lot volume.
step4.riskPerTradeHelper: 1.0% recommended for prop firm and institutional risk safety.
step4.fixedLotHelper: Exact volume copied regardless of signal lot size.
step4.volumeMultiplierHelper: e.g. 0.5 executes half of provider size; 2.0 doubles provider size.
step4.maxSlippageHelper: Rejects trade if broker spread/slippage exceeds this threshold.
step4.hardStopDesc: If daily equity loss touches this ceiling, all positions close instantly and copier pauses immediately to protect your funded prop firm evaluation or live capital.
step4.advancedTitle: Advanced Risk Math & Margin Safety Parameters
step4.maxOpenPositionsHelper: Concurrent cap across all active signal channels.
step4.marginSafetyHelper: No new trades allowed if margin level drops below this %.
step4.dailyLossLimitHelper: Monetary loss threshold to prevent tilt & runaway drawdowns.

step5.title: End-to-End Pipeline Verification
step5.desc: Injects a synthetic test signal through the local engine to verify Shared-Memory Ring Buffer IPC latency, order calculation, and bridge connector execution with {{broker}}.
step5.successDesc: All 5 stages passed: Licensing, Read-Only Telegram, Broker Pipe, Risk Guard, and Sub-ms Execution.
